description: Chat-load page stage in headless Chromium (perf100, browser_bench.mjs; the WebKit arm is webviews-chat-load-webkit): the shipped agent pane bundle opens 100-, 1,000- and 10,000-turn chats from a real acpmux daemon cold and by switch, and the mock chat; first paint, interactive, received JSON, requests, DOM nodes, daemon CPU, Chromium's script, layout, style and task time and heap, and the scroll to the first message.
not_measurable: run.sh takes ACPMUX_BIN OUT_DIR, not the runner's --app --tag --out, and the Linux runner builds no acpmux binary and no agent pane bundle at the measured commit; run it by hand with PERF_RESULT_DIR set.
